A diagram showing the flow of the Qur'an's preservation. Top panel: The Prophet (SAW) radiating lines to "Memorizers (Huffadh)" and "Scribes writing on bones/leaves". Middle panel: Abu Bakr and Zayd bin Thabit gathering these into a single "Suhuf (Manuscript)". Bottom panel: Uthman sending identical books (Mushaf) out to different cities marked with arrows (Kufa, Basra, Damascus, Makkah).
